P.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Veigar''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Phenomenal Evil'' for each enemy {{tip|champion}} hit by his {{tip|abilities}}, and 5 stacks whenever he scores an enemy champion {{tip|takedown}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Phenomenal Evil:}} For each stack, '''Veigar''' gains {{sti|AP|{{as|1 ability power}}}}.

Q.name: Baleful Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Veigar''' blasts a dark bolt in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first two enemies hit.
Q.description2: If this kills an enemy, it generates 1 stack of ''{{ai|Phenomenal Evil Power|Veigar|Phenomenal Evil}}'', tripled against large {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.

W.name: Dark Matter
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Veigar''' casts down a mass of dark matter that strikes the target location after a {{rutngt|1.2}} {{tt|delay|from the start of the cast time}}, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area during the delay and afterwards dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
W.description2: ''Dark Matter's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced based on stacks of ''{{ai|Phenomenal Evil Power|Veigar|Phenomenal Evil}}''.
W.cooldown: {{pp|type=[[File:Phenomenal_Evil_Power.png|20px|link=Veigar#Phenomenal_Evil_Power]] [[Veigar#Phenomenal_Evil_Power|Phenomenal Evil]] stacks|8*0.9^(x-1);...;0|0 to 900 for 19;...;∞|formula=8 * 0.9^N. ''N{{equals}}Number of times that 50 Phenomenal Evil stacks are earned.''}}

E.name: Event Horizon
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Veigar''' forms a cage at the target location that erects after a {{fd|0.5}} second delay, remaining there for 3 seconds. Enemies that collide with the edges of the cage are {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a duration.
E.description2: ''Event Horizon'' can affect enemies only once per cast.

R.name: Primordial Burst
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Veigar''' sends a primordial burst at the target enemy champion that deals {{as|magic damage}}, increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 100*2/3|formula=1.5% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health. ''This is capped at 66.66% '''missing''' health.''}}|health}}.
R.leveling: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|175 to 325}} {{as|(+ {{ap|65 to 75}}% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|175*2 to 325*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|65*2 to 75*2}}% AP)}}}}
